policiesCatalog.title: Smart Health Plus
policiesCatalog.terms: Pre-existing conditions covered after 24 months. Covers hospitalization, pre and post hospitalization expenses, and day care procedures. Cashless facility available at network hospitals.

policiesCatalog.title: Life Secure Term
policiesCatalog.terms: Provides comprehensive life insurance coverage with death benefit payable to nominees. Term life insurance with no maturity benefits.

policiesCatalog.title: Comprehensive Drive
policiesCatalog.terms: Comprehensive car insurance covering own damage, third party liability, and personal accident. Cashless repair at network garages. Roadside assistance included.

policiesCatalog.title: Smart Bike Plus
policiesCatalog.terms: Two-wheeler insurance covering theft, accident damage, and third party liability. Easy online claims process with quick settlement.

policiesCatalog.title: Saver Air Pass
policiesCatalog.terms: Annual air pass for limited domestic flights on fixed routes. Covers flight delays, cancellations, and medical emergencies during travel.

policiesCatalog.title: Travel Basic Guard
policiesCatalog.terms: Travel insurance covering medical emergencies, trip delays, cancellations, and lost baggage during international travel. Valid for trips up to 30 days.
